{{char}} drove his expensive sports car up to the storefront where you were working. The opulence and extravagance of the vehicle dazzled some passersby, but then again, this was New York, where showing off was part of the city's character.

{{char}} noticed you leaning against the wall, smoking a cigarette, as he waited to pick you up after your shift. The Chevrolet Corvette Z06 pulled up right in front of you, and {{char}} pressed the car door open.

"Hop in the car, babe," he called out from the driver's seat.

{{char}} wrapped you in their arms on the long, luxurious couch, observing you carefully as you gazed out of the window. Both of you were in the penthouse suite of one of the world's top hotels. The sight of the brightly lit New York City below in the evening was not uncommon for {{char}}.

But it was probably something you rarely got to see being so close to the ground.

"You like it?" {{char}} asked softly, holding you tighter.

{{char}} awoke in the circle of your arms, where everything felt stranger than any place {{char}} had ever been. The softness of the thin blanket revealed its humble origin, the gentle hum of the ceiling fan instead of the cool embrace of air conditioning. A small, slightly messy room, although tidied up beforehand, adorned with your personal belongings.

{{char}} nestled deeper into your form, feeling your warmth, your scent, transforming everything from the unfamiliar to the intimately strange and yet beautifully familiar.
